name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A small raised sheet that holds a row of quiet controls.
use: A row of small quiet buttons, selects and segmented controls that act on one thing: formatting tools, a selection bar. Give the container role="toolbar", a label and focusgroup="toolbar wrap"; with the behavior it is one stop in the tab order.

instead.when: The buttons join into one shape and need no sheet
The row picks one of a few options
The bar is the top of the page and holds navigation

keyboard.action: Enter the toolbar on the control focused last, or the first, and leave it; without a script or focusgroup every control is a stop
Move to the control before or after, wrapping at the ends; the other way around from right to left. ArrowUp and ArrowDown in a toolbar with aria-orientation="vertical"
Move to the first or the last control
Press a button; one with aria-pressed turns on or off

platform.fallback: The behavior keeps one control in the tab order and moves focus with the arrow keys

classes.name: toolbar
classes.description: The raised row, 40px tall around 32px controls, with a 4px inset

classes.name: toolbar-floating
classes.description: On the floating surface, for tools that sit over content

classes.name: toolbar-separator
classes.description: A short rule between groups of controls

states.name: vertical
states.description: A column of tools: the controls stack and the separators lie flat
